name: brix-signage
title: Brix Signage
description: Search your digital signage screens, files and playlists, change what a screen plays, send screen commands and post a message to screens.
author: brixsignage

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Make an API key in Brix in Settings › AI, API & MCP › API keys. The key starts with ak_.

commands.name: search-screens
commands.title: Search Screens
commands.subtitle: Brix
commands.description: Find a screen, see what it shows, change its content or send a command to it.

commands.name: search-files
commands.title: Search Files
commands.subtitle: Brix
commands.description: Find images, videos and other files in your Brix library.

commands.name: search-playlists
commands.title: Search Playlists
commands.subtitle: Brix
commands.description: Find a playlist and play it on a screen.

commands.name: post-message
commands.title: Post Message to Screens
commands.subtitle: Brix
commands.description: Show a headline on your screens for a set time. Then the screens go back to their usual content.

commands.name: screen-status
commands.title: Screen Status
commands.subtitle: Brix
commands.description: Show in the menu bar how many screens are offline.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
